===
missing separator before a label
===

program MissingSeparator;
begin
  Work L:
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (label
        (identifier)
        (ERROR (identifier)))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
missing separator after goto
===

program MissingGotoSeparator;
begin
  goto L L:
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (goto
        (kGoto)
        (identifier)
        (MISSING ";"))
      (label (identifier))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
missing separator in repeat body
===

program MissingRepeatSeparator;
begin
  repeat
    Work L:
  until B
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (repeat
        (kRepeat)
        (statements
          (label
            (identifier)
            (ERROR (identifier))))
        (kUntil)
        (identifier))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

===
missing separator in try body
===

program MissingTrySeparator;
begin
  try
    Work L:
  finally
    Cleanup
  end
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName (identifier))
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (try
        (kTry)
        (statements
          (label
            (identifier)
            (ERROR (identifier))))
        (kFinally)
        (statements
          (statement (identifier)))
        (kEnd))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))
